blocks.html: This was my first attempt at creating a platformer. I created all the assets and code that run in the game. I also created a modular design to all the different mechanics like enemy movement, cutscenes, and interactables.

items: Created modular puzzle pieces for reuse
Created a dialogue system from scratch
Created a visual editor guide to help with map creation
Created multiple mechanics that the player learns over time
